purpose: Modular Xtrata manifest template set for collections, namespaces, data vaults, runtime apps, finance, identity, governance, rights, agents and cross-chain mappings.

rootLevelFiles.use: Most common/simple collection or marketplace launch template.
Xtrata .x namespace standard and name-resolution layer.
Token, wrapped asset, receipt or LP token template.
Revenue split, royalty split or treasury payment template.

folders.collections: Art collections, preservation migrations, AV archives and full composable collection examples.
folders.finance: Financial protocol, asset/token, treasury split and oracle/index manifests.
folders.data: Data vaults, append-only event logs and cross-chain/bridge mappings.
folders.runtime-and-agents: Runtime apps, BVST/composable examples and AI agent memory manifests.

designPrinciple: Contracts enforce state and value movement. Manifests describe, verify, organise, reconstruct and make systems legible to wallets, indexers, marketplaces and users.

coreStandards.use: Human-readable common standards for all Xtrata manifests.
Machine-readable baseline standard for validators and repo agents.
Alignment scan and recommendations for bringing the manifest set to v1.0.
